The '''Solaran War of Unification''' was the seven-year conflict that led to the formation of [[Solara]] in early 1538.

Old source material says the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]] and the [[Kingdom of Congrave]] united the country after defeating the [[Kingdom of Albion]]. The victorious coalition then selected [[John "Lee" Greener]] as the first [[President of Solara]] because of his actions during the war.

== Background ==

The war belongs to the early modern Solaran homeland before the modern parliamentary state existed. The source identifies three predecessor states: Solan, Congrave, and Albion. It does not give full dynastic histories, exact borders, or the immediate trigger for the conflict.

This draft therefore treats the war as a state-formation struggle among predecessor polities rather than as a fully mapped campaign.

== Outcome ==

By early 1538, Albion had been defeated and the Solan-Congrave coalition created Solara. The new state was organized as a parliamentary democracy rather than as a simple annexation by one predecessor monarchy.

Greener's selection as first president gave the new state a civilian constitutional office connected to wartime leadership, coalition legitimacy, and the need to hold the former predecessor territories together.

== Canon Limits ==

The source does not provide battlefield names, casualties, commanders beyond Greener, peace terms, or what happened to Albion's ruling house. Publication should avoid adding those details until a fuller Solaran early-history pass or user canon ruling supplies them.
